<thought>The task requires counting the number of chemically equivalent hydrogen atoms (unique proton environments) in a specific compound. To determine this, I need the molecular structure, typically provided as a SMILES string, so I can generate or analyze its ¹H NMR spectrum. No structural information was supplied, and there is no tool to request additional data. Without the structure, I cannot reliably count the unique hydrogen environments.</thought>
<final_answer>Insufficient information to determine the number of unique hydrogen environments.</final_answer>
